operations.title: GET request
operations.description: Sends an HTTP GET request and returns {status, body}.

parameters.title: URL
parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to request. Supports templates.

parameters.title: Headers
parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Optional. A JSON object of request headers. Supports templates.

output.name: body
output.description: Response body, parsed as JSON when possible

parameters.title: Headers

parameters.title: Body
